info.title: OpenAPI Datatruck
info.description: To be able to use Datatruck OpenAPI you should create tokens from your dashboard. Go to your dashboard and create token with appropriate scopes and expiration. Expiration and scopes are optional as well as description for your token, but remember name is required.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of loads (orders) with related stops, trips, tags, documents, and ETA details.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 25, default 10).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: ORM field path to order by. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-created_datetime`, `load_pay`, `status`).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects. Each object has `column` (ORM field path), `value`, and `contains` (operator). Supported operators: `is`, `is_not`, `is_in`, `is_not_in`, `contains`, `before`, `after`, `greater_than`, `less_than`, `between`, `between_datetime`, `isnull`, `today`, `exclude`, `exclude_in`. Example: `[{"column":"status","value":"booked","contains":"is"},{"column":"load_pay","value":"1000,5000","contains":"between"}]`

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new load in the Datatruck Transportation Management System (TMS).

get.description: Fetch details of a specific order by its ID.

parameters.name: pk
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the order

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of work orders with related tasks, payments, attachments, and tags. `from_date` and `to_date` are required query parameters.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Start date filter (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: End date filter (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after from_date.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 25, default 10).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: ORM field path to order by. Prefix with `-` for descending.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects. Each object has `column`, `value`, and `contains` (operator). Supported operators: `is`, `is_not`, `is_in`, `is_not_in`, `contains`, `before`, `after`, `greater_than`, `less_than`, `between`, `between_datetime`, `isnull`, `today`, `exclude`, `exclude_in`.

200.description: List of work orders retrieved successfully

post.description: Creates a new work order with associated tasks, compensation details, and notes.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated dispatcher board showing each dispatcher with their assigned drivers and aggregated trip statistics (total miles, gross, driver pay, RPM, trips).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 25, default 10).

200.description: List of dispatcher board retrieved successfully

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active drivers, including their truck, trailer, dispatcher, team driver, payment tariff, and emergency contact details.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 25, default 10).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: ORM field path to order by. Prefix with `-` for descending.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects. Each object has `column`, `value`, and `contains` (operator). Supported operators: `is`, `is_not`, `is_in`, `is_not_in`, `contains`, `before`, `after`, `greater_than`, `less_than`, `between`, `between_datetime`, `isnull`, `today`, `exclude`, `exclude_in`.

200.description: Successful response with a paginated list of drivers.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active trailers, including their driver/co-driver operators, trailer type, dispatch status, unit number, VIN, make, model, and year.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 25, default 10).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term matched against unit_number, plate_number, vin, make, and model (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter trailers by exact status value.

200.description: Successful response with a paginated list of trailers.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active trucks, including their unit number, plate number, VIN, make, model, year, status, state, and assigned driver/co-driver.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 25, default 10).

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: ORM field path to order by. Prefix with `-` for descending.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of filter objects. Each object has `column`, `value`, and `contains` (operator). Supported operators: `is`, `is_not`, `is_in`, `is_not_in`, `contains`, `before`, `after`, `greater_than`, `less_than`, `between`, `between_datetime`, `isnull`, `today`, `exclude`, `exclude_in`.

200.description: Successful response with a paginated list of trucks.

put.description: Updates an existing driver's account info, contact details, driver type, employee status, license details, and dispatch status.

parameters.name: pk
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the driver to update.

post.description: Creates a new driver with the provided details, including name, contact information, driver type, employee status, and optional license and dispatch information.
Creates a new trailer with the provided details, including make, model, year, unit number, VIN, and optional fields such as plate number, state, status, and driver assignments.

Creates a new truck with the provided details, including make, model, year, plate number, unit number, VIN, state, ownership, and optional fields such as status, driver assignments, and warranty information.
